levels.surface: أبي الحسن صالح بن أبي حماد

notes: two routes (taḥwīl with «جميعا» and «قالوا»); the first (the Sa'd and Hasan b. Tarif line) ends at بكر بن صالح, and the text writes no further names for it, so it is not extended

«قَالَ أَبِي عليه السلام لِجَابِرِ» : the Imam Abu Ja'far speaks inside the story, and Jabir answers with the tablet's testimony; rule 6 cannot settle which of them is the last link, so the chain stops at Abu Abd Allah
the title «[ ]» and the Imam's blessings are left out; the bare «أبي» in the first route is the compiler's father
